title: View and Mark Tasks as Complete
user_story: As a user, I want to see all my tasks and mark them as done, so that I can track my progress visually.
acceptance_criteria: All added tasks are displayed in a list on the main page.
Each task displays its text content clearly.
Clicking a checkbox or toggle next to a task marks it as complete and applies a visual indicator such as strikethrough or dimmed text.
Clicking again removes the completion state, restoring the original appearance.
